basic_info.description: Sophisticated, Modern, & Luxurious Home in Desirable Ingleside Heights! This fully renovated, 2-level home, spanning 1,650 SQFT, 2,500 SQFT lot, offers 3BD/2.5BA. This home equipped with security cameras, Intelligent Motion Sensor LED stair lights, & more. Recently transformed from studs, new roof, new electrical, new plumbing, all done with permits. Behind its modern facade, you will find White Oak hardwood floors, recessed lighting, abundance of natural light that flows seamlessly through the open, airy layout. Upper level boasts spacious living/dining area, chefs kitchen with premium finishes, quartz countertops, S/S appliances,& sleek modern cabinetry, 2BD/1.5BA. Downstairs, you'll find a family room with wet bar, 1BD/1BA. The low maintenance backyard is perfect for family gatherings and quiet relaxation. Washer/dryer hookups ready in laundry closet, tankless water heater, EV charging outlet ready, 1-car garage, & driveway parking. Minutes to Stonestown, H Mart, West portal, CCSF, SFSU, Muni, Bart and freeway access, plus half block from the renovated Merced Heights playground including volleyball court & tennis court. A must see!
